The winner of the latest completed Formula 1 World Championship (2023) is **Max Verstappen**, driving for Red Bull Racing.

This was Verstappen’s third consecutive world title. He dominated the season, winning 19 out of 22 races.

As for the **current 2024 season**, Max Verstappen is the defending champion and currently leads the standings, but the championship is still ongoing and has not yet been officially decided.
